ticker: GOLD $4,065 ▲4.9% W/W · BTC $76,000 ▼3.0% W/W · BRENT $96 · US 10Y 4.90% · NASDAQ ▼2.2% THU · USD/CNY YUAN +4.2% YTD

head: GOLD +$190.
*BITCOIN -$4,000*
*IN TWO HOURS.*
scenes.say: Gold ripped almost two hundred dollars off a one year low. Bitcoin got hit by a four thousand dollar candle. And Washington changed hands. This is your week in markets, in five minutes, with facts, not hype.

head: GOLD
scenes.say: Let's start with gold. Last Friday it touched about three thousand eight hundred seventy, a one year low. Then buyers stepped in hard. By Thursday it hit four thousand one hundred forty seven, a move of almost seven percent from the low.

head: NOW $4,065
*THE FIRST PULLBACK*
scenes.say: Right now it is pulling back to around four thousand sixty five, as rate fears return. The level to watch is four thousand seventy. Holding above it keeps the rebound alive. Losing it opens the door back toward four thousand.

head: CHINA BUYS
*BARS & COINS +26%*
scenes.say: Part of the gold story is China. According to the China Gold Association, demand for gold bars and coins jumped twenty six percent in the first nine months of the year, while jewelry fell thirty four percent. Chinese buyers want gold as savings, not decoration.

head: PBOC TAPS
*THE BRAKES ON THE YUAN*
scenes.note: FIRST HIKE IN ~5 YEARS · FROM NOV 15
scenes.say: And the People's Bank of China moved too. It will raise the foreign exchange reserve ratio for banks from four to six percent, starting November fifteenth, the first hike in about five years. The goal: slow a yuan that gained about four percent this year.

head: MIDTERMS:
*A NEW CONGRESS*
scenes.say: In the United States, the midterm elections reshaped Washington. Democrats reportedly won both the House and the Senate. Markets read it fast: chip and data center stocks sold off on fears of tighter rules, and the Nasdaq dropped about two percent on Thursday.

head: CRYPTO BILL
*DEADLINE: JAN 3*
scenes.note: CLARITY ACT MUST MOVE BEFORE THE NEW SESSION
scenes.say: For crypto, the clock is ticking. The CLARITY Act, the market structure bill, has until January third to move before the new Congress starts. If it stalls, the work may start again from zero.

head: JOBLESS CLAIMS
*189K - LOWEST*
*SINCE 1969*
scenes.say: Then came the jobs data. Weekly jobless claims fell to one hundred eighty nine thousand, the lowest since nineteen sixty nine. A job market this strong keeps a December rate hike on the table, and that is exactly what pressured gold and crypto on Thursday.

head: BITCOIN
*$81K → $75K*
scenes.say: Now Bitcoin. On Wednesday it tagged eighty one thousand two hundred. On Thursday it flushed to seventy five thousand two hundred, a four thousand dollar candle in about two hours. It now trades near seventy six thousand, down around three percent on the week.

head: ETF OUTFLOWS
*-$1.07 BILLION*
scenes.say: The pressure came from the funds. Bitcoin E T Fs lost about one point one billion dollars in five sessions, and ether E T Fs lost about four hundred thirty million. The level to watch is seventy five thousand seven hundred, the election night low.

head: $2.85B
*HACK FUNDS FROZEN*
scenes.note: RARE GOOD NEWS FOR THE INDUSTRY
scenes.say: There was some good news. Binance says two point eight five billion dollars from its hack is now frozen or intercepted. That is a rare win for an industry that usually loses that money for good.

head: $46 BILLION
*OF REAL ASSETS*
*ON BLOCKCHAIN*
scenes.say: The biggest long term story keeps growing quietly: tokenization. According to R W A dot x y z, about forty six billion dollars of real world assets now live on blockchains, across thirty six networks.

head: CREDIT & TREASURIES
*LEAD THE WAY*
scenes.say: Private credit and U S Treasury bonds lead the way. This is Wall Street moving onto crypto rails, and it is one more reason the CLARITY Act deadline matters for the whole market.

head: BRENT
*BACK NEAR $96*
scenes.say: Oil added fuel to the fire. Brent bounced back toward ninety six dollars. Expensive oil means more inflation pressure, and more reason for the Fed to stay tough.

head: WHAT TO WATCH
*GOLD $4,070 · BTC $75.7K*
scenes.note: THE JOBS REPORT SETS THE TONE
scenes.say: So what to watch next week? The reaction to Friday's jobs report, the four thousand seventy level on gold, and seventy five thousand seven hundred on Bitcoin. Hold them, and the bulls stay in the game. Lose them, and the rate fears win.

head: GOLD OR BITCOIN
*NEXT WEEK?*
scenes.say: Which one wins next week, gold or Bitcoin? Tell me in the comments. Subscribe for daily crypto and gold facts, and see you next Sunday. This is not financial advice, just data.
